JS Minifier

Minify JavaScript using the real Terser engine with compression and mangling, showing genuine errors and byte savings.

Minified with the real Terser engine (compress + mangle) in your browser. Only the Terser library loads from a CDN; your code is never sent anywhere.




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Paste your JavaScript into the input box.
  2. Click Minify JS and wait a moment for Terser to run.
  3. Check the output, or read the real error message if your code has a syntax problem.
  4. Copy the result or download it as a .min.js file.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How does the minification work?
It loads the Terser library and runs Terser.minify with compress and mangle enabled — the same engine many build tools use.
Will it show me syntax errors in my code?
Yes. If your code has a syntax error, Terser reports the real error message with its location instead of silently failing.
Is my code uploaded anywhere?
No. The Terser library loads from a CDN, but your code is minified locally in the browser and never sent anywhere.
